Celebrations

Banana walnut layer cake

Diós torta

12 months+ Replaced 45 min 8 portions

Use ground walnut only after walnut is already tolerated, one nut at a time. This is occasional party food, not a weekly cake. The yogurt filling contains milk. Freeze the plain layers and add yogurt after thawing.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 2 very ripe bananas (mashed; the only sweetener)
  • 2 eggs (baked until fully set)
  • 80 g finely ground walnut (only after walnut is already tolerated; one nut, not a mix)
  • 80 g plain wheat flour (no salt in the batter)
  • 2 tbsp rapeseed or olive oil (for a softer crumb)
  • 120 g plain pasteurized yogurt (unsweetened filling; adds milk)

Allergens

milkeggglutentree nut

Method

  1. Mash the bananas until smooth, then stir in the oil and the eggs.
  2. Fold in the flour and the finely ground walnut.
  3. Divide the batter between two small tins.
  4. Bake at 180 C until the centre is fully set and a skewer comes out clean.
  5. Cool completely, then spread yogurt between the layers.
  6. Cut a small slice and serve it with no icing and no whole nuts.

Replaced

Sugar icing and whole nuts were the problem. Keep toys out of the cake, and serve it only occasionally.

Make a small two-layer cake of egg, ground walnut, and flour, sweetened only with very ripe banana mashed into the batter and filled with plain yogurt. Leave out sugar icing, whole walnuts, and tiny toys.
